thread:
maria_pmad: Quick sync — we need to lock sampling + release gates for the observability surfaces (dashboards, trace hooks, cost breakdown, error analytics). Customer asks have pushed this up the roadmap.

sam_eng: +1. Is the ask primarily per-route cost attribution and full-span traces for errors?

olivia_csm: From ProdAlpha and Acme, yes. They want per-model and per-route cost boxes in the dashboard and sampled traces that include the full request -> model -> downstream call. Also retention for 30d on hotspots.

jordan_infra: Two tradeoffs: sampling density vs ingest cost, and where to do enrichment (agent vs backend). We can do adaptive sampling by error/latency and a steady low-rate background sample.

lee_sre: We should define clear launch gates. My proposal: 1) per-route cost accuracy within 15% on 95th percentile of traffic patterns, 2) sampled traces capture 99% of error types after 1 week, 3) dashboards render under 1s for standard query.

maria_pmad: Those are helpful. Can we make the sampling strategy concrete? e.g., baseline 0.1% global, error-triggered 100%, latency-triggered 10%, plus scope for customer escalations (dedicated sampling for Dedicated/Private).

sam_eng: That maps to implementation. Quick sketch of config (pseudo):

```yaml
sampling:
  baseline_rate: 0.001
  error_rate: 1.0
  latency_rate: 0.1
  per_route_overrides: {}
```

sam_eng: We'll need per-customer overrides and a quota so this doesn't blow ingest budgets. Also, KV cache for traces to stitch model calls.

olivia_csm: Customers will want an opt-in UI control in Console for "high-fidelity tracing" per route. Also an export hook to S3/BigQuery for long-tail retention.

maria_pmad: Let's capture acceptance criteria for product sign-off:
- Dashboard: per-route cost breakout card, configurable time window (1h/24h/30d), sample confidence estimate shown.
- Traces: sampled trace view with model-call spans and latency/error tags, can open raw JSON.
- Cost: Top-10 cost hotspots and cost-per-call metric.
- UX: toggle to enable per-route high-fidelity export.

jordan_infra: Implementation notes: need sampling decisions at the edge to tag spans early; enrich span with model-version, model-variant, quantization profile. Backend will apply tail-sampling and forward selected traces to storage.

lee_sre: Rollout plan suggestion: canary to 5% orgs (low QPS) for 2 weeks, monitor ingest, dashboard latency, and false-positive errors. If OK, 50% for 1 week, then GA. Also include automatic fallback to low-sample mode if ingest > threshold.

maria_pmad: Timeline ask: Customer pilots in 6 weeks, GA in 12. Is that feasible?

sam_eng: Tight but doable if we scope initial GA to dashboard + basic traces (no long-term export). We can add export and per-customer long retention in a follow-up.

olivia_csm: Communicate that to customers: pilot = high-fidelity per-route tracing + dashboard; export is alpha.

maria_pmad: OK. Action items: @sam_eng create RFC with the sampling config + quota mechanism by EOD Friday. @jordan_infra write infra constraints for edge tagging and tail-sampling. @olivia_csm draft customer pilot comms. I'll own launch gates doc and acceptance checklist.

ops-bot: Reminder: #deploy-bot scheduled infra maintenance Thurs 03:00 UTC — may affect canary window.

sam_eng: Noted — will avoid canary during that window.

lee_sre: One more: add e2e test to simulate traffic skew (one model heavy) so per-route cost math is validated.

maria_pmad: Agreed. We'll add test owning to the RFC. Thanks everyone :party_parrot!
